title: G-equivariant (co)sheaves as functors on ]X/G[ resp. [X/G]
body_html:
$G$-equivariant (co)sheaves as functors on $]X/G[$ resp.\ $[X/G]$

Given a cellular $G$-action on $X$ (Locally finite regular CW complex with cellular G-action), the two nominally independent structures — the poset (face relation) and the group action — are packaged together in the two orbit categories $]X/G[$ and $[X/G]$ (The orbit categories ]X/G[ and [X/G]). Every equivariant sheaf and cosheaf on $X$ arises as a functor on the appropriate one.

Statement

Proposition. For any category $\mathscr C$:

$$ \Sh_G(X, \mathscr C) \;\simeq\; \underline{\mathrm{Fun}}(\, ]X/G[,\; \mathscr C\, ) \qquad\text{and}\qquad \Cosh_G(X, \mathscr C) \;\simeq\; \underline{\mathrm{Fun}}(\, [X/G],\; \mathscr C\, ). $$

Equivalently, $\Cosh_G(X, \mathscr C) \simeq \underline{\mathrm{Fun}}(\, ]X/G[^{\mathrm{op}},\; \mathscr C\, )$.

Taking $G = \{e\}$ recovers $\Sh(X, \mathscr C) \simeq \underline{\mathrm{Fun}}(]X[, \mathscr C)$ and $\Cosh(X, \mathscr C) \simeq \underline{\mathrm{Fun}}([X], \mathscr C)$.

Sketch of the equivalence (sheaf case)

Given $(V, a) \in \Sh_G(X, \mathscr C)$, define $F :\, ]X/G[\, \to \mathscr C$ by

  • $F(E) := V_E$;
  • for $g \in \Hom_{]X/G[}(E, E')$ (i.e.\ $g \cdot E \preceq E'$), $F(g) := r^V_{g \cdot E,\, E'} \circ a^V_{g, E}$.

Functoriality ($F(h) \circ F(g) = F(hg)$ for composable $g : E \to E'$, $h : E' \to E''$) is a direct chase using the equivariance axiom of $a^V$ and transitivity of $r^V$.

Inverse. Given $F :\, ]X/G[\, \to \mathscr C$, set $V_E := F(E)$, $r^V_{E, E'} := F(e : E \to E')$ (the identity element $e \in G$ as a morphism $E \to E'$ whenever $E \preceq E'$), and $a^V_{g, E} := F(g : E \to g \cdot E)$.

Cosheaf case is dual: $F : [X/G] \to \mathscr C$ takes morphisms in the reverse direction, matching corestriction.

Corollary: stalk actions as endomorphism actions

Under the equivalence, the stalk action of $\Stab_G(E)$ on $V_E$ (a $G$-equivariant sheaf/cosheaf datum) is the endomorphism action $\End_{]X/G[}(E) \cong \Stab_G(E)$ on $F(E)$ (The orbit categories ]X/G[ and [X/G]).

Lean formalization

What is done. The two-sided packaging of $G$-equivariant (co)sheaves is fully in place:

class GEquivariantSheaf {C : Type*} [Category C] (F : Sheaf X C) where
  act : ∀ (g : G) (E : X), F.obj (op E) ≅ F.obj (op (g • E))
  act_map : ...    -- naturality with restriction
  act_one : ...    -- unit
  act_mul : ...    -- multiplicativity
class GEquivariantCosheaf {C : Type*} [Category C] (F : Cosheaf X C) where
  ...              -- analogous
structure GCosheaf (C : Type*) [Category C] where
  base : Cosheaf X C
  equiv : GEquivariantCosheaf G X base
instance : Category (GCosheaf G X C) := ...

$G$-equivariant cosheaves are bundled as GCosheaf G X C with a Category instance (natural transformations commuting with act at every cell). This is what the reduction node Reduction of G-equivariant cosheaves to a QFD uses as its LHS.

What is in progress. The forward direction $\Cosh_G(X, \mathscr C) \to \Fun(\,]X/G[^{\mathrm{op}}, \mathscr C)$ is now three quarters formalised in SheafOnBuilding.GCosheafToFun:

noncomputable def GCosheaf.mapOfG
    (W : GCosheaf G X C) {E E' : X} (g : G) (hg : g • E' ≤ E) :
    W.base.obj (op E) ⟶ W.base.obj (op E') :=
  W.base.map (homOfLE hg).op ≫ (W.equiv.act g E').inv

theorem GCosheaf.mapOfG_one (W : GCosheaf G X C) (E : X) :
    W.mapOfG (1 : G) ... = 𝟙 (W.base.obj (op E))         -- proved

theorem GCosheaf.mapOfG_mul (W : GCosheaf G X C)
    {E E' E'' : X} (g₂ g₁ : G) (h₂ : g₂ • E' ≤ E) (h₁ : g₁ • E'' ≤ E') :
    W.mapOfG (g₂ * g₁) _ = W.mapOfG g₂ h₂ ≫ W.mapOfG g₁ h₁
                                                          -- statement in; proof pending

noncomputable def GCosheaf.toFunctor (W : GCosheaf G X C) :
    (OrbitCat G X)ᵒᵖ ⥤ C                                  -- statement in; body blocked

mapOfG_mul's proof is a straightforward but tedious diagram chase using act_map (naturality) + act_mul (multiplicativity) + eqToHom bookkeeping. It is being filled in.

Architectural obstruction on toFunctor. The body of GCosheaf.toFunctor is written out but cannot be typechecked under the current OrbitCat-as-abbrev design. With

abbrev OrbitCat (G X : Type*) : Type _ := X

the type X carries two competing Category X instances:

  • the preorder-derived one (from [PartialOrder X]) — used by Cosheaf X C = Xᵒᵖ ⥤ C;
  • the scoped OrbitCat.category — used by (OrbitCat G X)ᵒᵖ ⥤ C.

When both meet in one term (which is exactly what toFunctor does), the elaborator's isDefEq search on the derived Category Xᵒᵖ loops. Bumping synthInstance.maxHeartbeats does not help — the two derivations produce non-defeq Hom types, so no attempt succeeds.

Fixes. Two clean options:

(a) refactor OrbitCat from abbrev to a structure wrapper, mirroring the design chosen for The category [X'/P] and its equivalence with the orbit category of G ×^P X''s PXPrimeOrbitCat — a genuinely fresh type carries only its own Category instance; (b) rework Cosheaf so its Xᵒᵖ no longer resolves through the ambient Category X.

Both are substantial refactors touching a lot of downstream declarations (OrbitCat → OnSubcomplex, ιOnSubcomplex, funCatEquivOfQFD, endMorEquivStabilizer, etc.); (a) is the cleaner and localises the change to OrbitCat.lean plus its direct users. Neither is done yet.

Sheaf side. Not started. Once the Cosheaf side lands and the architectural fix is in place, the Sheaf $F(g) = r \circ a$ construction is mechanically dual.

Consequences for the reduction

The reduction theorem Reduction of G-equivariant cosheaves to a QFD $$ \Cosh_G(X, \mathscr C) \;\simeq\; \Fun([S]^{\mathrm{op}}, \mathscr C) $$ is fully Lean-formalised on its categorical scaffolding half (funCatEquivOfQFD in SheafOnBuilding.OrbitFunEquiv) but still leans on the pending $\Cosh_G \simeq \Fun(]X/G[^{\mathrm{op}})$ piece for closure.

Similarly the induced-space form The category [X'/P] and its equivalence with the orbit category of G ×^P X': the equivalence $[X'/P] \simeq ]X/G[$ is fully Lean-formalised (as PXPrimeOrbitCat.toInducedOrbitCat_isEquivalence), so once the Cosh ≃ Fun forward direction lands, the reduction

$$ \Cosh_G(G \times^P X', \mathscr C) \simeq \Fun([X'/P]^{\mathrm{op}}, \mathscr C) $$

composes automatically via Equivalence.congrLeft on $\iota_*^{\mathrm{op}}$.

Hypotheses used

Statement Hypotheses consumed
$\Sh_G / \Cosh_G$ as bundled types MulAction G X, GCellComplex G X
$F(g) = r \circ a$ construction (co)sheaf functoriality + act_map (naturality)
Inverse (functor to equivariant sheaf) act_one, act_mul
mapOfG_one in Lean GEquivariantCosheaf.act_one_inv

None involve a Lean-kernel axiom.

lean_refs.name: SheafOnBuilding.GEquivariantSheaf
lean_refs.signature:
class GEquivariantSheaf {C : Type*} [Category C] (F : Sheaf X C) where
  /-- Stalk-level action of `g` at `E` as an iso. -/
  act : ∀ (g : G) (E : X), F.obj E ≅ F.obj (g • E)
  /-- Naturality against sheaf restrictions. -/
  act_map : ∀ (g : G) {E F' : X} (h : E ≤ F'),
    (act g E).hom ≫ F.map (homOfLE (GCellComplex.smul_le g h)) =
      F.map (homOfLE h) ≫ (act g F').hom
  /-- Identity: `act 1 E = 𝟙`, modulo `eqToHom` for `1 • E = E`. -/
  act_one : ∀ E : X,
    (act 1 E).hom ≫ eqToHom (show F.obj ((1 : G) • E) = F.obj E by rw [one_smul]) =
      𝟙 (F.obj E)
  /-- Multiplicativity. -/
  act_mul : ∀ (g h : G) (E : X),
    (act (g * h) E).hom ≫
        eqToHom (show F.obj ((g * h) • E) = F.obj (g • h • E) by rw [mul_smul]) =
      (act h E).hom ≫ (act g (h • E)).hom

lean_refs.name: SheafOnBuilding.GEquivariantCosheaf
lean_refs.signature:
class GEquivariantCosheaf {C : Type*} [Category C] (F : Cosheaf X C) where
  /-- Stalk-level action of `g` at `E` as an iso. -/
  act : ∀ (g : G) (E : X), F.obj (op E) ≅ F.obj (op (g • E))
  /-- Naturality against cosheaf restrictions: for `h : E ≤ F'`,
  ```
  F.obj (op F') ──── F.map (homOfLE h).op ──► F.obj (op E)
       │                                          │
       │ (act g F').hom                           │ (act g E).hom
       ▼                                          ▼
  F.obj (op (g•F')) ─ F.map (...smul_le...).op ► F.obj (op (g•E))
  ```
  -/
  act_map : ∀ (g : G) {E F' : X} (h : E ≤ F'),
    F.map (homOfLE h).op ≫ (act g E).hom =
      (act g F').hom ≫ F.map (homOfLE (GCellComplex.smul_le g h)).op
  /-- Identity: `(act 1 E).hom = 𝟙`, modulo `eqToHom` for `1 • E = E`. -/
  act_one : ∀ E : X,
    (act 1 E).hom ≫
        eqToHom (show F.obj (op ((1 : G) • E)) = F.obj (op E) by rw [one_smul]) =
      𝟙 (F.obj (op E))
  /-- Multiplicativity. -/
  act_mul : ∀ (g h : G) (E : X),
    (act (g * h) E).hom ≫
        eqToHom (show F.obj (op ((g * h) • E)) = F.obj (op (g • h • E))
          by rw [mul_smul]) =
      (act h E).hom ≫ (act g (h • E)).hom

structure GCosheaf (C : Type*) [Category C] where
  /-- Underlying cosheaf `F : Xᵒᵖ ⥤ C`. -/
  base : Cosheaf X C
  /-- The equivariant structure witnessing `G`-equivariance. -/
  equiv : GEquivariantCosheaf G X base
lean_refs.docstring: Bundled `G`-equivariant cosheaf on `X` with values in `C`.

lean_refs.name: SheafOnBuilding.GCosheaf.category
lean_refs.signature:
instance category : Category (GCosheaf G X C) where
  Hom F F' := Hom F F'
  id F := Hom.id F
  comp α β := Hom.comp α β
  id_comp _ := Subtype.ext (Category.id_comp _)
  comp_id _ := Subtype.ext (Category.comp_id _)
  assoc _ _ _ := Subtype.ext (Category.assoc _ _ _)

lean_refs.name: SheafOnBuilding.GCosheaf.mapOfG_mul
lean_refs.signature:
theorem GCosheaf.mapOfG_mul (W : GCosheaf G X C)
    {E E' E'' : X} (g₂ g₁ : G)
    (h₂ : g₂ • E' ≤ E) (h₁ : g₁ • E'' ≤ E') :
    W.mapOfG (g₂ * g₁)
        (show (g₂ * g₁) • E'' ≤ E by
          rw [mul_smul]; exact le_trans (GCellComplex.smul_le g₂ h₁) h₂) =
      W.mapOfG g₂ h₂ ≫ W.mapOfG g₁ h₁
